author: Yffe
content: Fixed in eae38c3 (thermite-spec/src/validator.rs). Root cause: the Expr::MethodCall arm accepted ANY method name structurally — 'req xs.frobnicate()' validated clean. Fix: bounded the allowlist with const BUILTIN_METHODS = [len] (REQ-3(c) — len is the only method the corpus uses in contracts: haystack.len(), xs.len()). A non-allowlisted method in a caged position now pushes SpecError::ForbiddenCall (REQ-4 iv); operands still recursed (REQ-5). Authority: .design/spec/spectherm-combinators.md REQ-3(c)/REQ-4(iv); thermite-design.md §4.2. Verify: divergence_unknown_method_call_in_contract_is_rejected now PASSES (un-ignored, asserts ForbiddenCall); bogus method in inv and in spec-fn body also rejected; cargo test -p thermite-spec 8 passed 0 failed 0 ignored; clippy/fmt/workspace-build PASS.
